metadata.title: Mashed Potatoes With Asiatic Pennywort
metadata.description:
A quick, easy and delicious mashed potatoes recipe with a healthy dose of roasted pumpkin seeds and Asiatic Pennywort. This recipe takes just minutes to make and is very healthy as the pumpkin seeds are loaded with omega 3 fatty acids and the pennywort is full of medicinal properties. 

This northeastern dish is loaded with goodness and goes really well with rotis as spread and as a side to steamed rice.
